messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- On 2026-03-20, Marcus moved from the Boreal team to the Atlas team. [valid 2026-03-20 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-03-20]
- The billing API has a deploy freeze from 2025-11-24 to 2025-12-02, covering the peak season. [constraint; valid 2025-11-11 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-11-11]
- Changes to the billing API need a rollback plan attached to the pull request. [constraint; valid 2025-04-02 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-04-02]
- As of 2026-01-12, the billing API is owned by the Ember team, which the Atlas team owned until then. [decision; valid 2026-01-12 to now; recorded by handover/2026-01-12-billing-api]
    earlier: From 2025-06-09, the billing API is owned by the Atlas team. [decision; valid 2025-07-03 to 2026-01-12; recorded by handover/2025-07-03-billing-api-correction]
    earlier: From 2025-06-09, the billing API is owned by the Boreal team. [valid 2025-06-09 to 2025-07-03; recorded by handover/2025-06-09-billing-api]
    earlier: Since 2025-03-07, the billing API is owned by the Ember team. [valid 2025-03-07 to 2025-06-09; recorded by handover/2025-03-07-billing-api]
    earlier: The billing API is owned by the Atlas team. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-03-07; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08-2]
- The Boreal team consists of Lena, after Marcus moved to the Atlas team on 2026-03-20. [valid 2026-03-20 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-03-20]
    earlier: The Boreal team consists of Lena and Marcus. [valid 2025-01-07 to 2026-03-20; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-07]
- On 2025-12-01, the Boreal team reported that the billing API's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump. [valid 2025-12-01 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-12-01]
- The billing API only ships on weekdays after 15:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-02-11 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-02-11]
- On 2025-06-09, Oskar wrote the billing API handover document for Lena. [valid 2025-06-09 to now; recorded by handover/2025-06-09-billing-api]
- The billing API depends on the ledger service for invoice postings. [valid 2025-01-09 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-09-2]
- On 2026-03-11, the Cinder team observed that the billing API's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade. [valid 2026-03-11 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-03-11-2]
- The billing API gates the new invoice flow behind feature-flags, because the rollout needs a per-tenant kill switch. [decision; valid 2025-09-30 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-09-30]
- On 2025-09-16, the Ember team handed the authentication gateway over to the Cinder team. [valid 2025-09-16 to now; recorded by handover/2025-09-16-auth-gateway]
- From 2025-03-03, the pager for the webhook dispatcher rings the Ember team. [valid 2025-03-03 to now; recorded by handover/2025-03-03-webhooks]
- The ledger service has a deploy freeze from 2026-03-30 to 2026-04-03 because of the fiscal year close. [constraint; valid 2026-03-11 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-03-11]
- As of 2026-05-29, for anything related to the Ember team, page Oskar this cycle, not Diego. [decision; valid 2026-05-29 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-05-29]
    earlier: As of 2026-04-13, for anything related to the Ember team, page Diego this cycle, not Oskar Lind. [decision; valid 2026-04-13 to 2026-05-29; recorded by standup/ember/2026-04-13]
    earlier: As of 2026-03-02, for anything related to the Ember team, page Oskar Lind for anything this cycle, not Diego. [decision; valid 2026-03-02 to 2026-04-13; recorded by standup/ember/2026-03-02]
    earlier: As of 2026-01-15, for anything related to the Ember team, page Diego, the primary on-call; Oskar is off rotation. [decision; valid 2026-01-15 to 2026-03-02; recorded by standup/ember/2026-01-15]
    earlier: For anything related to the Ember team, page Oskar. [decision; valid 2025-03-31 to 2026-01-15; recorded by standup/ember/2025-03-31]
- The job scheduler leader lease will be shortened to ten seconds, a decision from the INC-2026-009 review. [decision; valid 2026-05-19 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-009]
- As of 2026-06-04, Priya Raman holds the Atlas team pager this cycle, taking over from Marcus. [decision; valid 2026-06-04 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-06-04]
    earlier: As of 2026-04-08, page Marcus for anything Atlas-related this cycle, not Priya Raman. [decision; valid 2026-04-08 to 2026-06-04; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-04-08]
    earlier: As of 2026-03-17, Priya Raman is the person to page for anything Atlas-related. [decision; valid 2026-03-17 to 2026-04-08; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-03-17]
